It’s the idea that local residents, not distant corporations or corrupt politicians, should have the final say over the resources and decisions that impact their lives. When workers and everyday people unite, they can reclaim control over local economies, services, and infrastructure. This isn’t just theory; it’s happening right now. It's time for workers to stand up and demand town power — to challenge the status quo and build a future where communities thrive on their own terms, not dictated by billionaire interests. The revolution starts at home.
